title: Draw Steel: Combat Tools
description:
Bringing the rules of Draw Steel to Foundry, one ability at a time.

Draw Steel: Combat Tools automates the combat mechanics of Draw Steel, including Forced Movement with full collision detection, Conditions (Frightened, Taunted, Bleeding, and more), Grab, Teleportation, NPC Death tracking, and class-specific ability automations. Each feature can be individually toggled in the settings, so you can use as much or as little of the module as fits your table.

recommends.reason: [Compatible] Wall Builder tags the walls it makes through Tagger.
[Compatible] Forced movement follows the terrain’s slopes and heights, and High Ground uses its edges.
[Compatible] A squad’s Stamina bar follows its Squad Threshold Marks setting, and doubled up health labels are hidden.
[Compatible] Every minion of a squad shows as able to act during the squad’s turn.
[Compatible] The HUD’s triggered action button follows the tracker here, for everyone at the table.
[Compatible] What it shows for a minion in a squad follows the Minion Health Estimate Display setting.
[Recommended] Easily build Draw Steel encounters to budget.
[Recommended] Puts all of the resource gain and spend in one place!
[Recommended] Hand drawn token art for Draw Steel monsters by Max Hamm
[Recommended] Makes it easier to run Downtime and keep track of projects.
[Recommended] Helpful for features where creatures share a space.
[Recommended] Makes conditions and effects easier to read and toggle.
[Recommended] Targeting by keyboard, an alternative to the Combat Tools pickers.

conflicts.reason: It should work, and does today, but newer features here are not fitted to its restyled sheets and messages, and keeping up with it is not planned.
